verdict.rationale: cubic's terminal CLI (`cubic review`) runs a local AI review of uncommitted changes. It does not write code itself: it 'generates a prompt that your coding agent can use to fix them', so the coding agent is a separate third-party tool. Its only code-fixing capability ('Fix with cubic') runs on the PR branch, not locally from the terminal. A local review CLI is an adjacent feature, not a terminal coding agent, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a coding agent locally from my terminal
